description: Negative: Procedure missing required procedureName field
shaclConstraintViolated: A procedure record shape must require health:procedureName (sh:minCount 1). Every procedure record must include a procedure name.
notes: Tests that a procedure without a name is rejected by validation. The invalid serialization is authored, but health:ProcedureRecord is asserted by proc-001/002/003 and is not defined as a class in health.ttl nor targeted by any shape, so nothing rejects it yet and the runner reports this fixture as UNSHAPED. It becomes a live negative the moment health:ProcedureRecord is defined and shaped.
